description: Header file defining the interface for native window operations in Android, including buffer management, querying, and transformation functions.

methods.name: ANativeWindowBuffer_getHardwareBuffer
methods.description: Converts an ANativeWindowBuffer into an AHardwareBuffer.

methods.name: ANativeWindow_OemStorageSet
methods.description: Stores a value into one of the 4 available OEM storage slots for a given native window.

methods.name: ANativeWindow_OemStorageGet
methods.description: Retrieves a value from one of the 4 OEM storage slots for a given native window.

methods.name: ANativeWindow_setSwapInterval
methods.description: Sets the swap interval for the native window surface.

methods.name: ANativeWindow_query
methods.description: Retrieves information about the native window based on specified query.

methods.name: ANativeWindow_queryf
methods.description: Retrieves floating-point information about the native window based on specified query.

methods.name: ANativeWindow_dequeueBuffer
methods.description: Dequeues a buffer from the native window for rendering.

methods.name: ANativeWindow_queueBuffer
methods.description: Queues a buffer for display after rendering.

methods.name: ANativeWindow_cancelBuffer
methods.description: Cancels a dequeued buffer if it is no longer needed.

methods.name: ANativeWindow_setUsage
methods.description: Sets usage flags for upcoming buffers.

methods.name: ANativeWindow_setBufferCount
methods.description: Sets the number of buffers associated with the native window.

methods.name: ANativeWindow_setBuffersDimensions
methods.description: Sets the dimensions of buffers dequeued after this call.

methods.name: ANativeWindow_setBuffersFormat
methods.description: Sets the pixel format of buffers.

methods.name: ANativeWindow_setBuffersTimestamp
methods.description: Associates a timestamp with queued buffers.

methods.name: ANativeWindow_setSharedBufferMode
methods.description: Enables or disables shared buffer mode.

methods.name: ANativeWindow_setAutoRefresh
methods.description: Enables or disables auto refresh in shared buffer mode.

methods.name: ANativeWindow_setAutoPrerotation
methods.description: Enables or disables auto prerotation based on buffer size and transform hints.
